items.exampleEn: More than five hundred students enrolled at the university this year.
items.exampleZh: 今年有五百多名學生在這所大學註冊入學。

items.exampleEn: The lawyer's specialty is family law.
items.exampleZh: 這位律師的專長是家事法。

items.exampleEn: Every new nurse is given a mentor for the first six months.
items.exampleZh: 每位新進護理師在前六個月都會有一位導師。

items.exampleEn: Children under six are eligible for free entry to the zoo.
items.exampleZh: 六歲以下的兒童可以免費進入動物園。

items.exampleEn: Nothing can compensate for the time I lost.
items.exampleZh: 什麼都彌補不了我失去的時間。

items.exampleEn: Each applicant will have a short interview with the manager.
items.exampleZh: 每位應徵者都會和經理進行簡短的面談。

items.exampleEn: Her sudden resignation surprised everyone in the office.
items.exampleZh: 她突然辭職，讓辦公室裡每個人都很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: The bank downsized its staff by moving many services online.
items.exampleZh: 那家銀行把許多服務移到網路上，藉此縮編人力。

items.sentenceEn: All applicants must send their forms before the end of the month.
items.sentenceZh: 所有申請人都必須在月底前寄出表格。

items.audioEn: Only players under eighteen are eligible to join the city's youth team.
items.audioZh: 只有未滿十八歲的球員才有資格加入市立青年隊。

items.sentenceEn: My mentor taught me how to deal with difficult customers.
items.sentenceZh: 我的導師教我怎麼應付難纏的顧客。

items.sentenceEn: The shop will compensate customers who received broken items.
items.sentenceZh: 那家店會補償收到破損商品的顧客。

items.stemEn: When their children moved out, my parents decided to ____ to a smaller apartment.
items.stemZh: 孩子們搬出去後，我爸媽決定換到一間比較小的公寓。

items.stemEn: After twenty years at the bank, Mr. Wang handed in his ____ and opened a cafe.
items.stemZh: 在銀行工作二十年後，王先生遞出辭呈，開了一家咖啡店。

items.passageEn: When Kevin's company decided to downsize last year, he was afraid of losing his job. Instead, his manager suggested that he enroll in a free training course in data design. Kevin was eligible because he had worked there for more than three years. During the course, an experienced colleague became his mentor and helped him find his specialty: making clear charts for reports. Six months later, a senior designer handed in her resignation, and the company looked for someone to replace her. There were more than twenty applicants, but Kevin got the job. The company also raised his salary to compensate for the extra work.
items.passageZh: 去年 Kevin 的公司決定縮編時，他很怕會丟掉工作。結果，他的經理建議他報名一個免費的資料設計訓練課程。Kevin 符合資格，因為他已經在那裡工作超過三年。上課期間，一位經驗豐富的同事成了他的導師，幫他找到自己的專長：為報告製作清楚的圖表。六個月後，一位資深設計師遞出辭呈，公司開始找人接替她。有二十多位應徵者，但 Kevin 得到了這份工作。公司也幫他加薪，補償額外的工作量。

questions.questionZh: Kevin 為什麼有資格參加訓練課程？
options: 他的經理是課程的老師之一
他在公司待超過三年了

items.promptZh: 我妹妹報名參加了一個週末烹飪班。
referenceEn: My sister enrolled in a weekend cooking class.
My younger sister has enrolled in a cooking course on weekends.
rubricZh: enroll 的用法，例如 enrolled in a class、enrolled on a course 等
「烹飪班」可寫，例如 cooking class、cooking course 等
時態合理（例如 enrolled、has enrolled 等）

items.promptZh: 這位年輕廚師很幸運，有一位經驗豐富的導師。
referenceEn: This young chef is lucky to have an experienced mentor.
The young chef is lucky because she has an experienced mentor.
rubricZh: mentor 指「導師」（例如 have an experienced mentor 等）
「很幸運」可寫，例如 is lucky to have、is lucky because 等
廚師用 he、she 都可以，不扣分
